## Purpose and scope

This companion governs operational procedure documentation and the tools that produce or display it: Standard Operating Procedures, decision trees, response playbooks, and associated tooling.

**In scope:**

- Document ownership under the Owner, Steward, and Custodian model
- Version control requirements for procedure documents
- Review cadences for procedure documentation
- Dependencies between procedure tools and the Tier 3 code tools they rely on

**Out of scope:**

- Warning assets that procedures reference (see @sec-flood-warnings)
- Code tool governance for tools that produce procedure documents (see @sec-r-governance and @sec-python-governance)
